title: Wasiyat - Zehra aur Hussain
body:
Khwab Mein Zahra Ny Baba Ko Jo Dekha Aik Shab
Khush Huin Paas Mein Baba Ky Chali Jaun Gi Ab
Haye Rony Lagi Bachon Ka Khayal Aa Gaya Jab
Yeh Khabar Hi Na Hui Paas Hussain Aa Gaye Kab
Amman Dhunden Gy Kahan Yad Agar Aayen Gi
Hum To Mar Jayen Gy Agar Aap Chali Jayen Gi
Maan Ny Jab Yeh Suna
Dil Tarhapny Laga
Pyar Karty Huye Fatima Ny Kaha
<<MINI>>
Dekho Hussain Mery Hussain
Aisy Nahi Kehty
Dekho Hussain Mery Hussain
Aisy Nahi Kehty
<<DIVIDER>>
Maan Kisi Ki Hamesha Rahi Hai Kabhi
Main Bhi Bichri Thi Amman Sy Bachpan Mein Hi
Maan Ky Jany Ka Dukh To Bahut Tha Magar
Dekho Main Bhi To Bin Maan Ky Jeeti Rahi
Tum Ko Meri Qasam Tum Sy Bichrhy Jo Hum
Zabt Kana Hai Ay Laal Maan Ka Yeh Gham
<<MINI>>
Dekho Hussain Mery Hussain
Aisy Nahi Kehty
<<DIVIDER>>
Haal Mainy Kisi Ko Sunaya Nahi
Khud To Roi Ali Ko Bataya Nahi
Mera Pehloo Shakista Hai Bas Is Liye
Apny Seeny Sy Tujh Ko Lagaya Nahi
Tooti Hain Paslian Kar Na Pai Bayaan
Kitni Takleef Mein Jee Rahi Hai Yeh Maan
<<MINI>>
Dekho Hussain Mery Hussain
Aisy Nahi Kehty
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujh Ko Maloom Hai Mery Noor E Nazar
Pyas Lagti Hai Tum Ko Bahut Raat Bhar
Pyas Sehny Ki Adat Bhi Dalo Zara
Pyasa Rehna Parhy Kab Kahan Kya Khabar
Pyas Tum Ko Lagy Aur Na Pani Mily
Yeh Dua Hai Keh Wo Din Na Aaye Kabhi
<<MINI>>
Dekho Hussain Mery Hussain
Aisy Nahi Kehty
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Mery Dil Mery Chain Mery Haseen
Na Pareshan Ho Maan Abhi Hai Yaheen
Dekho Marny Ki Ab Bat Karna Nahi
Maot Sy Pehly Hum Mar Na Jayen Kaheen
Tum Ho Duniya Meri Tum Sy Hai Zindagi
Tum Ko Dekhun To Chalti Hain Sansen Meri
<<MINI>>
Dekho Hussain Mery Hussain
Aisy Nahi Kehty
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum Ko Khana Bhi Fizza Khilaye Gi Ab Aur Sawerey Wohi Munh Dhulaye Gi Ab
Tum Jahan Jao Gy Sath Jaye Gi Woh
Sath Maan Ki Tarah Woh Nibhaye Gi Ab
Paly Gi Ab Wohi Zidd Na Karna Koi
Khush Raho Gy To Maan Ko Bhi Ho Gi Khushi
<<MINI>>
Dekho Hussain Mery Hussain
Aisy Nahi Kehty
<<DIVIDER>>
Din Woh Aaya Keh Jab Chal Basi Fatima
Maan Ki Maiyat Py Shabbir Ny Di Sada
Tum Bulao Gi To Pas Aaun Ga Main
Tooty Bandy Kafan Fatima Ny Kaha
Aa Ja Ay Meri Jaan Tujh Py Qurban Maan
Jab Hussain Aa Ky Lipty To Boli Yeh Maan
<<MINI>>
Dekho Hussain Mery Hussain
Aisy Nahi Kehty
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Raza Aur Zeeshan Dill Tham Lo
Ro Ky Shabbir Kehty Thy Amman Suno
Dekho Tum Ny Bulaya To Main Aa Gaya
Jab Bulaun Ga Aao Gi Wada Karo
<<DIVIDER>>
Maan Ny Wada Kiya Beta Chup Ho Gaya
Jab Janaza Utha Phir Na Aai Sada
Mere Hussain
